name: Angie's Restaurant (Logan) Famous Warm Utah Scone with Whipped Honey Butter
whyItWorks: Angie's iconic pillowy white-flour Utah scone with whipped honey butter is completely seedless and low-fiber, though fried in oil.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Blot any excess oil with a napkin, use a modest smear of the whipped honey butter, or ask for a baked homemade white dinner roll with honey butter during a flare.
watchOuts: Utah scones are deep-fried dough; swap to Angie's baked dinner rolls if flaring
